title: Anthropic, SpaceX and Meta Cash Grabs
summary: If it feels like it’s getting stuffy, that’s because the AI industry’s biggest names are doing their best to suck all the air out of the room. On Monday, Anthropic, SpaceX and Meta Platforms all unveiled their respective plans for raising gobs of cash to fund their AI ambitions, which could collectively add up to almost a quarter of a trillion dollars, while the getting is still good. This isn’t going to make it any easier for the weaker AI players, especiallystruggling neoclouds, to find fresh air to breathe in the form of capital.The biggest headline grabber of the day, of course, was Anthropic’s S-1 filing for its initial public offering. You can read a comprehensive breakdown of the most interesting details in that filing by my colleagueshere. Anthropic didn’t say in its paperwork how much it plans to raise, though Reuters haspreviously reportedthat figure could be as much as $100 billion.On Monday, Metaannouncedit has its sights set on a similar figure, as much as $95 billion through stock offerings. This wasn’t a surprise: Meta had telegraphed that a fundraising was in the offing as part of its recent third-quarter earnings report. In afiling last week, Meta made it clear it planned to move expeditiously to do the fundraising in part due to a congested pipeline of recent and future deals from the likes of Alphabet, SpaceX, Anthropic and OpenAI. A committee of Meta’s board, the filing said, “recognized that timing is important to secure capital before competitors saturate various funding options.”But perhaps the most intriguing fundraising effort of the three companies was SpaceX’s $40 billion financing agreement with an entity managed by Apollo Global Management, through which the company will lease graphics processing units for its data centers. It’s the largest GPU financing in history, SpaceXsaid. title: NVIDIA /SkillSpector
summary: SkillSpector Security scanner for AI agent skills. Detect vulnerabilities, malicious patterns, and security risks before installing agent skills. Overview AI agent skills (used by Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, etc.) execute with implicit trust and minimal vetting. In the 31,132-skill analyzed subset of the research dataset, 26.1% of skills contain vulnerabilities and 5.2% show likely malicious intent . SkillSpector helps you answer: "Is this skill safe to install?" SkillSpector is part of the NVIDIA Verified Skills pipeline , which scans, evaluates, and signs agent skills before publication. Skills that pass are published to the NVIDIA skills catalog . Documentation Scan agent skills before installation — Hosted guide: when to scan, how to read a report, and how to gate installs. Development guide — Architecture, package layout, and how to extend the analyzer pipeline. Analysis resource bounds — Fail-closed bundle, parser, nested-artifact, ledger, and finding ceilings. Pi extension — Install SkillSpector as a Pi tool for scanning skills from inside agent sessions. OpenCode extension — Install SkillSpector as an OpenCode tool and /skillspector command for scanning skills from inside agent sessions. Features Multi-format input : Scan Git repos, URLs, zip files, directories, or single files 71 vulnerability patterns across 17 categories: prompt injection, data exfiltration, privilege escalation, supply chain, excessive agency, output handling, system prompt leakage, memory poisoning, tool misuse, rogue agent, anti-refusal, trigger abuse, dangerous code (AST), taint tracking, YARA signatures, MCP least privilege, and MCP tool poisoning Two-stage analysis : Fast static analysis + optional LLM semantic evaluation Live vulnerability lookups : SC4 queries OSV.dev for real-time CVE data with automatic offline fallback Multiple output formats : Terminal, JSON, Markdown, and SARIF reports Risk scoring : 0-100 score with severity labels and clear recommendations Baseline
title_es: NVIDIA lanza SkillSpector para auditar seguridad de agent skills
bajada: NVIDIA presentó SkillSpector, un escáner de seguridad para skills de agentes IA que detecta vulnerabilidades y patrones maliciosos antes de la instalación. Análisis de 31,132 skills muestran que 26.1% contienen vulnerabilidades y 5.2% tienen intención maliciosa probable.
bajada_en: NVIDIA released SkillSpector, a security scanner for AI agent skills that detects vulnerabilities and malicious patterns before installation. Analysis of 31,132 skills shows 26.1% contain vulnerabilities and 5.2% likely have malicious intent.

title: Show HN: Hob - Open-source, on device alternative to Claude Cowork and ChatGPT
summary: Hey HN, I'm Christian and this is a new OSS project I've been noodling on for the last couple of weeks. Hob is a free, MIT-licensed desktop app for Mac, Windows and Linux that works on your files the way the Claude and ChatGPT desktop apps do, except the model runs on your own computer. It uses open-weight models (currently Gemma 4 and gpt-oss). All your chats and files never leave your system. The only things that go online are web search (can be turned off in settings) and any MCP connectors you add yourself.Main features:- Automatically finds the best open-weight model for your hardware on first install (Mac/Linux/Windows)- Writes sandboxed Python code for ad hoc tools (data processing, document conversion, graphs etc.)- Built-in web search (powered by SearXNG)- MCP support- Image recognition- CRUD to your local filesystem- Works fully offline with no internetBefore building this I tried every local AI app I could find, but it seemed each one had different problems. The main thing I noticed is that none of them could do what the ChatGPT and Claude apps do with your files, e.g. read and change files in a folder, look at images, run code in a sandbox, draw a chart. The most advanced thing any of them did was paste a plain text file into a small context window, which basically failed as soon as you had a file larger than a few KB. I couldn't find anything that could easily parse images and bigger PDFs.The OSS solutions that were more advanced all seemed to default to hosted models (either OSS or closed), which defeats the entire point of the privacy that on-device OSS offers. They also seemed to push towards an account/open-core style business.I build it using Electron bridged with llama.cpp in its own process. title: nightly-labs /openbot
summary:

conversation, and provides local queues, file transfers, an embedded browser, and agent-to-agent
messaging in one desktop app. Warning OpenBot is a development preview. Agents currently run with danger-full-access and approvalPolicy: never . They can read and modify files, run commands, use the network, and control
the embedded browser without per-action confirmations after the explicit first-launch consent.

Custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints and custom ACP agents, with detection of local model servers (Ollama, LM Studio) and installed agents. Per-agent context monitoring with automatic compaction before long threads exhaust the model window. FIFO message queues with pause, resume, cancellation, and crash-safe persistence. title: Ψ-0.6: Adaptive Streams of Thought in a Unified Vision-Language World Model [R]
summary: Chain-of-thought transformed AI reasoning, but it is limited to words.What's the physical-world analogue?Introducing Ψ-0.6, one model that reasons in *streams of thought*: words, depth, motion, camera pose, and imagined scenes. And it learns when to use which!Ψ-0.6 surpasses leading open-weight models on complex spatial reasoning (MindCube, zero-shot).On FlowBench, it outperforms other world models at predicting how objects move. Trained on simulated rooms, it transfers to real robot tabletops.One model as perceiver, VLM, world model, reasoner, and policy. RL learns which representation to reason through.Thread (with video):https://x.com/khai_loong_aw/status/2115099953433600011Paper:https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.32177Website:https://neuroailab.github.io/psi-website/blog/psi-0-6.htmlCode:https://github.com/neuroailab/psi-0.6submitted by/u/FaeriaManic[link][comments]
title_es: Ψ-0.6: modelo unificado de visión-lenguaje con razonamiento multimodal
bajada: Investigadores presentaron Ψ-0.6, un modelo que extiende chain-of-thought a múltiples modalidades: palabras, profundidad, movimiento y poses de cámara. El modelo supera a modelos open-weight líderes en razonamiento espacial complejo y transfiere exitosamente a robots reales.
bajada_en: Researchers introduced Ψ-0.6, a model that extends chain-of-thought to multiple modalities: words, depth, motion, and camera poses. The model outperforms leading open-weight models on complex spatial reasoning and successfully transfers to real robots.

title: Papers with Code is now open-source [P]

title_es: Firefox Smart Window añade relleno automático de formularios con IA
bajada: Mozilla actualiza Smart Window con una nueva función que rellena formularios en línea usando información de tus pestañas abiertas. El asistente puede extraer datos de LinkedIn o portafolios para completar aplicaciones de trabajo automáticamente.
bajada_en: Mozilla updated Smart Window with a new feature that fills online forms using information from your open tabs. The assistant can extract data from LinkedIn or portfolios to auto-complete job applications.

title: Meta Slightly Increases Equity Fundraising Plan to $97.5 Billion
summary: Meta Platforms is slightly increasing the size of its planned stock sales to fund AI investments to a total of $97.5 billion from $95 billion, the company said.The company is increasing the common stock offering in its fundraising plan to $25 billion from $22.5 billion, Meta said in an...
title_es: Meta aumenta plan de recaudación de fondos a $97.5 mil millones
bajada: Meta incrementó ligeramente su plan de venta de acciones para financiar inversiones en IA a $97.5 mil millones, desde los $95 mil millones iniciales. El aumento refleja la inversión masiva que la empresa está realizando en infraestructura y desarrollo de modelos.
bajada_en: Meta slightly increased its stock sale plan to fund AI investments to $97.5 billion from $95 billion. The increase reflects the massive investment the company is making in infrastructure and model development.
